description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the RefreshTokenRepository in the OrangeHRM OAuth plugin, testing refresh token creation, persistence, revocation, and status checks.

classes.name: RefreshTokenRepositoryTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the OAuth RefreshTokenRepository's functionality, including creation, persistence, revocation, and status checks.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, loads fixtures, and instantiates the repository.

methods.name: testGetNewRefreshToken
methods.description: Tests creation of a new refresh token entity.

methods.name: testPersistNewAccessToken
methods.description: Tests persisting a new refresh token, verifying stored data.

methods.name: testPersistNewAccessTokenWithExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to persist a refresh token with a duplicate access token throws an exception.

methods.name: testRevokeAccessToken
methods.description: Tests revoking a refresh token and confirming its revoked state.

methods.name: testRevokeAccessTokenWhichAlreadyRevoked
methods.description: Ensures revoking an already revoked token does not alter its state.

methods.name: testRevokeNonExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Checks that revoking a non-existent token does not cause errors.

methods.name: testIsAccessTokenRevoked
methods.description: Validates that revoked tokens are correctly identified.

methods.name: testIsAccessTokenRevokedForNonExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Checks that non-existing tokens are treated as revoked.
